API reference

dftlab.core.element

Lightweight Element class used across dftlab.

This module provides a simple, well-documented Element value type that stores a chemical element’s symbol, atomic number and standard atomic mass.

The documentation strings follow Sphinx/reStructuredText conventions so they can be included in the project API docs.

Example

>>> from dftlab.core.element import Element
>>> Element("C", 6, 12.011)
Element(symbol='C', atomic_number=6, atomic_mass=12.011)
class dftlab.core.element.Element(symbol: str, atomic_number: int, atomic_mass: float)[source]

Bases: object

Representation of a chemical element.

Parameters:

  • symbol (str) – The element symbol, e.g. "H", "He". Must be a non-empty string starting with an uppercase letter.

  • atomic_number (int) – The element’s atomic number (Z). Must be a positive integer.

  • atomic_mass (float) – Standard atomic mass in atomic mass units (u). A positive float.

symbol, atomic_number, atomic_mass

Notes

This class is intentionally minimal. Validation is performed on construction to catch obvious errors early.

symbol: str
atomic_number: int
atomic_mass: float
